name: index
description: Create a vector index of raster datasets.

input_arguments.name: quiet
input_arguments.description: Quiet mode (no progress bar or warning message)

input_arguments.name: input
input_arguments.description: Input raster datasets

input_arguments.name: output-format
input_arguments.description: Output format

input_arguments.name: creation-option
input_arguments.description: Creation option

input_arguments.name: layer-creation-option
input_arguments.description: Layer creation option

input_arguments.name: overwrite
input_arguments.description: Whether overwriting existing output dataset is allowed

input_arguments.name: update
input_arguments.description: Whether to open existing dataset in update mode

input_arguments.name: overwrite-layer
input_arguments.description: Whether overwriting existing output layer is allowed

input_arguments.name: append
input_arguments.description: Whether appending to existing layer is allowed

input_arguments.name: output-layer
input_arguments.description: Output layer name

input_arguments.name: recursive
input_arguments.description: Whether input directories should be explored recursively.

input_arguments.name: filename-filter
input_arguments.description: Pattern that the filenames in input directories should follow ('*' and '?' wildcard)

input_arguments.name: min-pixel-size
input_arguments.description: Minimum pixel size in term of geospatial extent per pixel (resolution) that a raster should have to be selected.

input_arguments.name: max-pixel-size
input_arguments.description: Maximum pixel size in term of geospatial extent per pixel (resolution) that a raster should have to be selected.

input_arguments.name: location-name
input_arguments.description: Name of the field with the raster path

input_arguments.name: absolute-path
input_arguments.description: Whether the path to the input datasets should be stored as an absolute path

input_arguments.name: dst-crs
input_arguments.description: Destination CRS

input_arguments.name: metadata
input_arguments.description: Add dataset metadata item

input_arguments.name: skip-errors
input_arguments.description: Skip errors related to input datasets

input_arguments.name: profile
input_arguments.description: Profile of output dataset

input_arguments.name: base-url
input_arguments.description: Base URL for STAC-GeoParquet href

input_arguments.name: id-method
input_arguments.description: How to derive STAC-GeoParquet 'id'

input_arguments.name: id-metadata-item
input_arguments.description: Name of metadata item used to set STAC-GeoParquet 'id'

input_arguments.name: source-crs-field-name
input_arguments.description: Name of the field to store the CRS of each dataset

input_arguments.name: source-crs-format
input_arguments.description: Format in which the CRS of each dataset must be written
